ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a black-and-white portrait of a person; the person is an older male, relatively bald at the top of the head, wearing round glasses, a dark suit and a white shirt; this portrait corresponds to Oswald Avery. Then according to the prompt in the question stem, "and colleagues," as well as "on the basis of Frederick Griffith's experiment on the transfer of bacterial hereditary traits," one can associate it with the Avery-MacLeod-McCarty experiment. This experiment, on the basis of Griffith's transformation experiment, further proved that the polymer that caused bacterial trait transformation and carried and transferred genetic information was DNA, rather than proteins or other substances.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的人物特征，并将其识别为 Oswald Avery；再读题干中“及同伴”“在 Frederick Griffith 的细菌遗传性状转移实验的基础上”这一提示，联想到 Avery-MacLeod-McCarty 实验；最后调用该实验结论：携带并转移遗传信息的多聚物是 DNA。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一张黑白人物肖像，人物为年长男性，头顶部较秃，戴圆形眼镜，穿深色西装和白衬衫；该肖像对应的是 Oswald Avery。再根据题干提示“及同伴”以及“在 Frederick Griffith 的细菌遗传性状转移实验的基础上”，可联想到 Avery-MacLeod-McCarty 实验。该实验在格里菲思转化实验基础上进一步证明，导致细菌性状转化、携带并转移遗传信息的多聚物是 DNA，而不是蛋白质等其他物质。
